note.fact: A continuous path which is smooth in space and C1 on each closed piece of a finite compact time partition has weak time derivative equal almost everywhere to its piecewise derivative, with bounded L2 path norm and bounded H^(-23/14) derivative norm.

grounds.reason: X uses weak derivative and essential suprema.
This is the specified initial path domain.
The finite partition, compactness, smoothness and continuity used at A001 are explicitly stated.

note.justification: Continuity on the finitely many compact pieces bounds the relevant path and derivative norms. Integrate against a compactly supported scalar test function and integrate by parts separately on each piece. The adjacent endpoint values agree, so all internal boundary terms cancel. Thus the piecewise derivative is the weak derivative, with no point masses.

arguments.proof:
intro a b s f hs hf
have hc := @yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b f hf
obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_Icc.image hc.1).bddAbove
refine ⟨fun k => (hc.2 k).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Icc, ?_, ?_⟩
· filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t ht
  exact (h_T013.2.2.2.1 s 0 (f t) hs (hf.1 t ht)).1
· apply lt_of_le_of_lt (essSup_le_of_ae_le (ENNReal.ofReal C) ?_) ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t ht
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  exact (h_T013.2.2.2.1 s 0 (f t) hs (hf.1 t ht)).2 |>.trans (hC ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩)

∀ (a b : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Path), a ≤ b → KdVPlan.SmoothOn a b f →
 KdVPlan.EssBound (-KdVPlan.pstar) a b (KdVPlan.dt f) ∧

 ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ →
 ∀ k, (∫ t in a..b, f t k * ((deriv φ t : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
 f b k * (φ b : ℂ)-f a k * (φ a : ℂ) - (∫ t in a..b, KdVPlan.dt f t k * (φ t : ℂ))

let D : KdVPlan.Path := fun t k => iteratedDerivWithin 1 (fun r => f r k) (Icc a b) t
have hD : KdVPlan.ContH 0 a b D := by simpa only [Nat.cast_zero] using hf.2 0 1

 intro k

  apply @yui_aux_0010 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b (-KdVPlan.pstar) D

    have ht' : t ∈ Ioo a b := by simpa only [min_eq_left hab, max_eq_right hab] using ht

arguments.statement: ∀ (a c b s : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Path), a ≤ c → c ≤ b → KdVPlan.EssBound s a c f → KdVPlan.EssBound s c b f → KdVPlan.EssBound s a b f
arguments.proof:
intro a c b s f hac hcb hl hr
let C₁ := essSup (fun t => ENNReal.ofReal (KdVPlan.hn s (f t))) (volume.restrict (Icc a c))
let C₂ := essSup (fun t => ENNReal.ofReal (KdVPlan.hn s (f t))) (volume.restrict (Icc c b))
have he : Icc a c ∪ Icc c b = Icc a b := Icc_union_Icc_eq_Icc hac hcb
refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· intro k
  rw [← he, aestronglyMeasurable_union_iff]
  exact ⟨hl.1 k, hr.1 k⟩
· rw [← he, ae_restrict_union_iff]
  exact ⟨hl.2.1, hr.2.1⟩
· apply lt_of_le_of_lt (essSup_le_of_ae_le (max C₁ C₂) ?_) (max_lt hl.2.2 hr.2.2)
  rw [← he, ae_restrict_union_iff]
  constructor
  · exact (ENNReal.ae_le_essSup _).mono fun t ht => ht.trans (le_max_left C₁ C₂)
  · exact (ENNReal.ae_le_essSup _).mono fun t ht => ht.trans (le_max_right C₁ C₂)

helper.statement:
∀ (a : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Path), KdVPlan.EssBound (-KdVPlan.pstar) a a (KdVPlan.dt f) ∧
 (∀ k, IntegrableOn (fun t => f t k) (Icc a a) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun t => KdVPlan.dt f t k) (Icc a a)) ∧
 ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ →
 ∀ k, (∫ t in a..a, f t k * ((deriv φ t : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
 f a k * (φ a : ℂ)-f a k * (φ a : ℂ) - (∫ t in a..a, KdVPlan.dt f t k * (φ t : ℂ))

arguments.statement:
∀ (p : Finset ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Path), a ≤ b →
 (∀ l r, a ≤ l → l < r → r ≤ b → (∀ x ∈ p, x ∉ Ioo l r) → KdVPlan.SmoothOn l r f) →
 KdVPlan.EssBound (-KdVPlan.pstar) a b (KdVPlan.dt f) ∧
 (∀ k, IntegrableOn (fun t => f t k) (Icc a b) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun t => KdVPlan.dt f t k) (Icc a b)) ∧
 ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ →
 ∀ k, (∫ t in a..b, f t k * ((deriv φ t : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
 f b k * (φ b : ℂ)-f a k * (φ a : ℂ) - (∫ t in a..b, KdVPlan.dt f t k * (φ t : ℂ))
arguments.proof:
classical
intro p
induction p using Finset.induction_on with
| empty =>
  intro a b f hab hf
  rcases hab.eq_or_lt with rfl | hab
  · exact @yui_aux_0016 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a f
  · apply @yui_aux_0013 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b f hab.le
    exact hf a b le_rfl hab le_rfl (by simp)
| @insert c p hcp ih =>
  intro a b f hab hf
  by_cases hc : c ∈ Ioo a b
  · apply @yui_aux_0015 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a c b f hc.1.le hc.2.le
    · apply ih a c f hc.1.le
      intro l r hal hlr hrc havoid
      apply hf l r hal hlr (hrc.trans hc.2.le)
      intro x hx
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx
      · exact fun h => (not_lt_of_ge hrc) h.2
      · exact havoid x hx
    · apply ih c b f hc.2.le
      intro l r hcl hlr hrb havoid
      apply hf l r (hc.1.le.trans hcl) hlr hrb
      intro x hx
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx
      · exact fun h => (not_lt_of_ge hcl) h.1
      · exact havoid x hx
  · apply ih a b f hab
    intro l r hal hlr hrb havoid
    apply hf l r hal hlr hrb
    intro x hx
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx
    · intro hh
      exact hc ⟨hal.trans_lt hh.1, hh.2.trans_le hrb⟩
    · exact havoid x hx

arguments.statement:
∀ (t : ℝ) (f g h : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g → KdVPlan.MemH 0 h →
∀ k : ℤ, Summable (fun j => KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t f) (KdVPlan.S t g)) j * KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD h) (k-j)) ∧
‖(fun (t : ℝ) (f g h : KdVPlan.Coeff) => KdVPlan.S (-t) (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t f) (KdVPlan.S t g))) (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD h))))) t f g h k‖ ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g*(KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.invD (fun _ => 1))*KdVPlan.hn 0 h)
arguments.proof:
intro t f g h hf hg hh k
have hsf := @yui_aux_0026 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 0 t f hf
have hsg := @yui_aux_0026 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 0 t g hg
have hi : ∀ j, ‖KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t f) (KdVPlan.S t g)) j‖ ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g := by
 intro j
 by_cases hj : j = 0
 · simp only [KdVPlan.P, if_pos hj, norm_zero]
   exact mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
 · simpa only [KdVPlan.P, if_neg hj, hsf.2, hsg.2] using (@yui_aux_0022 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 _ _ hsf.1 hsg.1 j).2
have hih := @yui_aux_0027 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 h hh
have hs : Summable (fun j => ‖KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD h) (k-j)‖) := by
 simp only [@yui_aux_0023 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013]
 simpa only [Function.comp_def, Equiv.subLeft_apply] using (Equiv.subLeft k).summable_iff.mpr hih.1
have hb : ∀ j, ‖KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t f) (KdVPlan.S t g)) j * KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD h) (k-j)‖ ≤ (KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g)*‖KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD h) (k-j)‖ := by
 intro j
 rw [norm_mul]
 exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hi j) (norm_nonneg _)
have hsum := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => norm_nonneg _) hb (hs.mul_left (KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g))
refine ⟨hsum.of_norm, ?_⟩
have hout : ‖KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t f) (KdVPlan.S t g))) (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD h)) k‖ ≤ (KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g)*(KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.invD (fun _ => 1))*KdVPlan.hn 0 h) := by
 apply (norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hsum).trans
 apply (hsum.tsum_le_tsum hb (hs.mul_left _)).trans
 rw [tsum_mul_left]
 apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
 simp only [@yui_aux_0023 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013]
 rw [@yui_aux_0028 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013]
 exact hih.2
change ‖KdVPlan.S (-t) (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t f) (KdVPlan.S t g))) (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD h)))) k‖ ≤ _
rw [@yui_aux_0023 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013]
by_cases hk : k = 0
· simp only [KdVPlan.P, if_pos hk, norm_zero]
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
· simpa only [KdVPlan.P, if_neg hk] using hout

have hb : ∀ j, ‖KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t f) (KdVPlan.S t g)) j * KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD h) (k-j)‖ ≤ (KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g)*‖KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD h) (k-j)‖ := by

∀ (t : ℝ) (f g h : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g → KdVPlan.MemH 0 h →

intro t f g h hf hg hh k
have hsf := @yui_aux_0026 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 0 t f hf
have hsg := @yui_aux_0026 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 0 t g hg
have hi : ∀ j, ‖KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t f) (KdVPlan.S t g)) j‖ ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g := by
 intro j
 by_cases hj : j = 0
 · simp only [KdVPlan.P, if_pos hj, norm_zero]
   exact mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
 · simpa only [KdVPlan.P, if_neg hj, hsf.2, hsg.2] using (@yui_aux_0022 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 _ _ hsf.1 hsg.1 j).2
have hih := @yui_aux_0027 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 h hh
have hs : Summable (fun j => ‖KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD h) (k-j)‖) := by

arguments.statement: ∀ (s a b : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Path) (C : ℝ), (∀ k, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => f t k) (volume.restrict (Icc a b))) → (∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Icc a b), KdVPlan.HB s (f t) C) → KdVPlan.EssBound s a b f ∧ KdVPlan.EssH s a b f ≤ max C 0
arguments.proof:
intro s a b f C hm hb
have he : essSup (fun t => ENNReal.ofReal (KdVPlan.hn s (f t))) (volume.restrict (Icc a b)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C :=
 essSup_le_of_ae_le (ENNReal.ofReal C) (hb.mono fun t ht => ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ht.2)
refine ⟨⟨hm, hb.mono fun t ht => ht.1, he.trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top⟩, ?_⟩
have hn := ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top he
simpa only [KdVPlan.EssH, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal'] using hn

arguments.statement: ∀ (μ : Measure ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Path), (∀ k, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => f t k) μ) → (∀ k, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => KdVPlan.S t (f t) k) μ) ∧ (∀ k, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => KdVPlan.S (-t) (f t) k) μ) ∧ (∀ k, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => KdVPlan.P (f t) k) μ) ∧ (∀ k, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => KdVPlan.invD (f t) k) μ)
arguments.proof:
intro μ f hf
refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· intro k
  have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I*(↑(t*(k : ℝ)^3) : ℂ))) := by fun_prop
  exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable.mul (hf k)
· intro k
  have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => Complex.exp (Complex.I*(↑((-t)*(k : ℝ)^3) : ℂ))) := by fun_prop
  exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable.mul (hf k)
· intro k
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · simpa [KdVPlan.P, hk] using (aestronglyMeasurable_const : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℂ)) μ)
  · simpa [KdVPlan.P, hk] using hf k
· intro k
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · simpa [KdVPlan.invD, hk] using (aestronglyMeasurable_const : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℂ)) μ)
  · simpa [KdVPlan.invD, hk] using (hf k).const_mul (Complex.I*(k : ℂ))⁻¹

arguments.statement: ∀ (s N : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.HB s (KdVPlan.cutoff N f) (KdVPlan.hn s f)
arguments.proof:
intro s N f hf
have hn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ KdVPlan.weight s k*‖f k‖^2 := fun k => mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _) (sq_nonneg _)
have hcut : ∀ k, 0 ≤ KdVPlan.weight s k*‖KdVPlan.cutoff N f k‖^2 ∧ KdVPlan.weight s k*‖KdVPlan.cutoff N f k‖^2 ≤ KdVPlan.weight s k*‖f k‖^2 := by
 intro k
 by_cases hk : |(k : ℝ)| ≤ N
 · simp only [KdVPlan.cutoff, if_pos hk]
   exact ⟨hn k, le_rfl⟩
 · simp only [KdVPlan.cutoff, if_neg hk, norm_zero, zero_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0), mul_zero]
   exact ⟨le_rfl, hn k⟩
have hs : KdVPlan.MemH s (KdVPlan.cutoff N f) := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => (hcut k).1) (fun k => (hcut k).2) hf
refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hs.tsum_le_tsum (fun k => (hcut k).2) hf)

arguments.statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (f : ℕ → KdVPlan.Coeff) (g : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.SeqConv s f g → Tendsto (fun n => KdVPlan.hn s (f n-g)) atTop (nhds 0)
arguments.proof:
intro s f g hf
apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
intro ε hε
obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hf.2 (ε/2) (half_pos hε)
refine ⟨m, fun n hn => ?_⟩
have hb := (hm n hn).2
have hp : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn s (f n-g) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
simpa only [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hp] using (lt_of_le_of_lt hb (half_lt_self hε))

 (∀ n, KdVPlan.MemH s (fn n)) → (∀ n, KdVPlan.MemH s (gn n)) → (∀ n, KdVPlan.MemH s (hn n)) →
 KdVPlan.SeqConv s fn f → KdVPlan.SeqConv s gn g → KdVPlan.SeqConv s hn h →

intro s C A hs hb fn gn hn f g h hfm hgm hhm hf hg hh
have hdf := @yui_aux_0047 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s fn f hf
have hdg := @yui_aux_0047 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s gn g hg
have hdh := @yui_aux_0047 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s hn h hh
have hgn := @yui_aux_0048 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s gn g hgm hg
have hhn := @yui_aux_0048 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s hn h hhm hh
have hbound := fun n => @yui_aux_0049 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s C A hs hb f (fn n) g (gn n) h (hn n) hf.1 (hfm n) hg.1 (hgm n) hh.1 (hhm n)
have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => KdVPlan.hn 0 (A (fn n) (gn n) (hn n)-A f g h)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
 apply squeeze_zero (fun n => Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (fun n => (hbound n).2)
 have h₁ := ((hdf.const_mul C).mul hgn).mul hhn
 have h₂ := ((hdg.const_mul (C*KdVPlan.hn s f)).mul hhn)
 have h₃ := hdh.const_mul (C*KdVPlan.hn s f*KdVPlan.hn s g)
 simpa only [mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] using (h₁.add h₂).add h₃
refine ⟨(hb f g h hf.1 hg.1 hh.1).1, ?_⟩
intro ε hε
obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hlim ε hε
refine ⟨m, fun n hn => ⟨(hbound n).1, ?_⟩⟩
have hp : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 (A (fn n) (gn n) (hn n)-A f g h) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
exact le_of_lt (by simpa only [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hp] using hm n hn)

 simpa only [mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] using (h₁.add h₂).add h₃
refine ⟨(hb f g h hf.1 hg.1 hh.1).1, ?_⟩

 A (f-f') g h = A f g h-A f' g h ∧ A f (g-g') h = A f g h-A f g' h ∧ A f g (h-h') = A f g h-A f g h') → (∀ f g h : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.MemH s g → KdVPlan.MemH s h → KdVPlan.HB 0 (A f g h) (C*KdVPlan.hn s f*KdVPlan.hn s g*KdVPlan.hn s h)) →
 ∀ (fn gn hn : ℕ → KdVPlan.Coeff) (f g h : KdVPlan.Coeff),
 (∀ n, KdVPlan.MemH s (fn n)) → (∀ n, KdVPlan.MemH s (gn n)) → (∀ n, KdVPlan.MemH s (hn n)) →
 KdVPlan.SeqConv s fn f → KdVPlan.SeqConv s gn g → KdVPlan.SeqConv s hn h →
 KdVPlan.SeqConv 0 (fun n => A (fn n) (gn n) (hn n)) (A f g h)

intro s C A hs hb fn gn hn f g h hfm hgm hhm hf hg hh
have hdf := @yui_aux_0047 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s fn f hf
have hdg := @yui_aux_0047 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s gn g hg
have hdh := @yui_aux_0047 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s hn h hh
have hgn := @yui_aux_0048 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s gn g hgm hg
have hhn := @yui_aux_0048 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s hn h hhm hh
have hbound := fun n => @yui_aux_0049 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s C A hs hb f (fn n) g (gn n) h (hn n) hf.1 (hfm n) hg.1 (hgm n) hh.1 (hhm n)
have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => KdVPlan.hn 0 (A (fn n) (gn n) (hn n)-A f g h)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
 apply squeeze_zero (fun n => Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (fun n => (hbound n).2)
 have h₁ := ((hdf.const_mul C).mul hgn).mul hhn
 have h₂ := ((hdg.const_mul (C*KdVPlan.hn s f)).mul hhn)
 have h₃ := hdh.const_mul (C*KdVPlan.hn s f*KdVPlan.hn s g)
 simpa only [mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] using (h₁.add h₂).add h₃
refine ⟨(hb f g h hf.1 hg.1 hh.1).1, ?_⟩
intro ε hε
obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hlim ε hε
refine ⟨m, fun n hnm => ⟨(hbound n).1, ?_⟩⟩
have hp : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 (A (fn n) (gn n) (hn n)-A f g h) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
exact le_of_lt (by simpa only [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hp] using hm n hnm)

arguments.statement: ∀ (s r a b : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Path), s ≤ r → KdVPlan.EssBound r a b f → KdVPlan.EssBound s a b f ∧ KdVPlan.EssH s a b f ≤ KdVPlan.EssH r a b f
arguments.proof:
intro s r a b f hsr hf
have hb : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Icc a b), KdVPlan.HB s (f t) (KdVPlan.EssH r a b f) := by
 filter_upwards [hf.2.1, @yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 r a b f hf] with t ht hb
 have hh := h_T013.2.2.2.1 s r (f t) hsr ht
 exact ⟨hh.1, hh.2.trans hb⟩
have hout := @yui_aux_0033 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s a b f (KdVPlan.EssH r a b f) hf.1 hb
simpa only [max_eq_left (show 0 ≤ KdVPlan.EssH r a b f from ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)] using hout

arguments.statement: ∀ (s a b : ℝ) (f g : KdVPlan.Path), KdVPlan.EssBound s a b f → KdVPlan.EssBound s a b g → KdVPlan.EssBound s a b (fun t => f t+g t) ∧ KdVPlan.EssH s a b (fun t => f t+g t) ≤ KdVPlan.EssH s a b f+KdVPlan.EssH s a b g
arguments.proof:
intro s a b f g hf hg
have hb : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Icc a b), KdVPlan.HB s (f t+g t) (KdVPlan.EssH s a b f+KdVPlan.EssH s a b g) := by
 filter_upwards [hf.2.1, hg.2.1, @yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s a b f hf, @yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s a b g hg] with t hft hgt hfb hgb
 have hh := @yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s (f t) (g t) hft hgt
 exact ⟨hh.1, hh.2.trans (add_le_add hfb hgb)⟩
have hm : ∀ k, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => (f t+g t) k) (volume.restrict (Icc a b)) := fun k => (hf.1 k).add (hg.1 k)
have hout := @yui_aux_0033 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s a b _ _ hm hb
simpa only [max_eq_left (show 0 ≤ KdVPlan.EssH s a b f+KdVPlan.EssH s a b g from add_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)] using hout

helper.name: yui_aux_0056
helper.statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (f d : KdVPlan.Path), 0 ≤ KdVPlan.Xnorm a b f d
helper.scope: Checked same-node theorem; available in later checks and the final body.

arguments.statement:
∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b-a ≤ 1 →
∀ f g h df dg dh : KdVPlan.Path, KdVPlan.XPath 0 a b f df → KdVPlan.XPath 0 a b g dg → KdVPlan.XPath 0 a b h dh →
KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.tri a b f g h) (C*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b f df*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b g dg*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b h dh)
arguments.proof:
have hsrc := h_E003
obtain ⟨c, hc, hb⟩ := hsrc
let d := c*KdVPlan.csrc^2
have hd : 0 < d := mul_pos hc (sq_pos_of_pos (@yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013))
refine ⟨2*d, mul_pos (by norm_num) hd, ?_⟩
intro a b ha hab hba f g h df dg dh hf hg hh
have hbound := (@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 c a b f g h df dg dh (hb.1 0 a b le_rfl zero_le_one ha hab hba f g h df dg dh hf hg hh)).1
have hf0 : KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b f ≤ KdVPlan.Xnorm a b f df := le_add_of_nonneg_right ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
have hg0 : KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b g ≤ KdVPlan.Xnorm a b g dg := le_add_of_nonneg_right ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
have hh0 : KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b h ≤ KdVPlan.Xnorm a b h dh := le_add_of_nonneg_right ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
have hfn : KdVPlan.EssH (-KdVPlan.pstar) a b f ≤ KdVPlan.Xnorm a b f df :=
 (@yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 (-KdVPlan.pstar) 0 a b f (by norm_num [KdVPlan.pstar]) hf.2.1).2.trans hf0
have hx₁ := @yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b f df
have hx₂ := @yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b g dg
have hx₃ := @yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b h dh
have hn₁ : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.EssH (-KdVPlan.pstar) a b f := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
have hn₂ : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b g := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
have hn₃ : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b h := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
refine ⟨hbound.1, hbound.2.trans ?_⟩
change d*(b-a)*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b f df*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b g dg*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b h dh+
 d*KdVPlan.EssH (-KdVPlan.pstar) a b f*KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b g*KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b h ≤ _
calc
 _ ≤ d*1*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b f df*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b g dg*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b h dh+
 d*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b f df*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b g dg*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b h dh := by
  gcongr
 _ = _ := by ring

arguments.statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (f g df dg : KdVPlan.Path), KdVPlan.XPath 0 a b f df → KdVPlan.XPath 0 a b (fun t => g t-f t) (fun t => dg t-df t) → KdVPlan.Xnorm a b g dg ≤ KdVPlan.Xnorm a b (fun t => g t-f t) (fun t => dg t-df t)+KdVPlan.Xnorm a b f df
arguments.proof:
intro a b f g df dg hf hd
have h₁ := (@yui_aux_0055 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 0 a b (fun t => g t-f t) f hd.2.1 hf.2.1).2
have h₂ := (@yui_aux_0055 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 (-KdVPlan.pstar) a b (fun t => dg t-df t) df hd.2.2 hf.2.2).2
have he₁ : (fun t => (g t-f t)+f t) = g := by funext t; abel
have he₂ : (fun t => (dg t-df t)+df t) = dg := by funext t; abel
rw [he₁] at h₁
rw [he₂] at h₂
unfold KdVPlan.Xnorm
linarith

arguments.statement:
∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b-a ≤ 1 →
 ∀ (vn wn zn : ℕ → KdVPlan.Path) (f g h df dg dh : KdVPlan.Path),
 KdVPlan.XConvergence a b vn f df → KdVPlan.XConvergence a b wn g dg → KdVPlan.XConvergence a b zn h dh →
 (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, KdVPlan.ZeroMean (vn n t) ∧ KdVPlan.ZeroMean (wn n t) ∧ KdVPlan.ZeroMean (zn n t)) →
 KdVPlan.SeqConv 0 (fun n : ℕ => KdVPlan.tri a b (vn n) (wn n) (zn n)) (KdVPlan.tri a b f g h)
arguments.proof:
intro a b ha hab hba vn wn zn f g h df dg dh hf hg hh _
obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := @yui_aux_0057 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013
have hb := hbound a b ha hab hba
let ef : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => KdVPlan.Xnorm a b (fun t => vn n t-f t) (fun t => KdVPlan.dt (vn n) t-df t)
let eg : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => KdVPlan.Xnorm a b (fun t => wn n t-g t) (fun t => KdVPlan.dt (wn n) t-dg t)
let eh : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => KdVPlan.Xnorm a b (fun t => zn n t-h t) (fun t => KdVPlan.dt (zn n) t-dh t)
let xf := KdVPlan.Xnorm a b f df
let xg := KdVPlan.Xnorm a b g dg
let xh := KdVPlan.Xnorm a b h dh
have ef0 : Tendsto ef atTop (nhds 0) := @yui_aux_0059 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b vn f df hf
have eg0 : Tendsto eg atTop (nhds 0) := @yui_aux_0059 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b wn g dg hg
have eh0 : Tendsto eh atTop (nhds 0) := @yui_aux_0059 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b zn h dh hh
have hfm : ∀ n, KdVPlan.XPath 0 a b (vn n) (KdVPlan.dt (vn n)) :=
 fun n => @yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b (vn n) hab (hf.2.1 n).1
have hgm : ∀ n, KdVPlan.XPath 0 a b (wn n) (KdVPlan.dt (wn n)) :=
 fun n => @yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b (wn n) hab (hg.2.1 n).1
have hhm : ∀ n, KdVPlan.XPath 0 a b (zn n) (KdVPlan.dt (zn n)) :=
 fun n => @yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b (zn n) hab (hh.2.1 n).1
have hxb₁ : ∀ n, KdVPlan.Xnorm a b (wn n) (KdVPlan.dt (wn n)) ≤ eg n+xg :=
 fun n => @yui_aux_0058 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b g (wn n) dg (KdVPlan.dt (wn n)) hg.1 (hg.2.1 n).2
have hxb₂ : ∀ n, KdVPlan.Xnorm a b (zn n) (KdVPlan.dt (zn n)) ≤ eh n+xh :=
 fun n => @yui_aux_0058 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b h (zn n) dh (KdVPlan.dt (zn n)) hh.1 (hh.2.1 n).2
have hdiff : ∀ n, KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.tri a b (vn n) (wn n) (zn n)-KdVPlan.tri a b f g h)
 (C*ef n*(eg n+xg)*(eh n+xh)+C*xf*eg n*(eh n+xh)+C*xf*xg*eh n) := by
 intro n
 let A₁ := KdVPlan.tri a b (fun t => vn n t-f t) (wn n) (zn n)
 let A₂ := KdVPlan.tri a b f (fun t => wn n t-g t) (zn n)
 let A₃ := KdVPlan.tri a b f g (fun t => zn n t-h t)
 have b₁ := hb _ _ _ _ _ _ (hf.2.1 n).2 (hgm n) (hhm n)
